a: Upload a screenshot or picture to **POST /read_image** (or /read_file). I describe it and try to read text on the screen. Works best with OPENROUTER_API_KEY or HF_TOKEN set on Render.
Upload a PDF to **POST /read_pdf** or /read_file. I extract text page by page. Scanned image-only PDFs may need a screenshot instead.
Upload a ZIP to **POST /read_zip** or /read_file. I list files inside and show text from code/docs when possible.
Yes. Supported: images/screenshots (png/jpg/webp), PDF, ZIP, and common text files. Use /read_file with multipart form field **file**.
